title: cyclobalanopsis fargesii
intro: Cyclobalanopsis fargesii, commonly known as Farges' oak, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fagaceae. It is a deciduous tree native to the mountainous regions of China, valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Cyclobalanopsis fargesii include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of this plant include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids.
